newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls back despite Sporitelna rebound.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls back despite Sporitelna rebound.

text.p: The Czech PX50 and RPIX indices fell back on Tuesday but heavier losses earlier in the day were mitigated by a recovery from savings bank Ceska Sportitelna.
The PX50 was down 1.2 points to 578 and the RPIX fell three to 1,167.
Sporitelna closed up four crowns at 350 after falling to 340 at the morning price fixing but dealers said they were baffled by the bank's continued strength adding that it was heavily overvalued.
"At over 300 it's overvalued and I'm afraid that this year they'll have to increase their provisions," said Jan Sykora of Wood & Company.
"Sporitelna would be fairly priced at around 300 I think," Sykora added.

Among the other blue chip issues, Komercni Banka led a downward moving pack with a 17 crown decline to 2,420. The PX50's biggest issue, SPT Telecom fell 11 crowns to 3,389 and CEZ lost five crowns to 1,045.

Changes in the broader market largely cancelled each other out leaving the major issues in control of the direction of the market once again. Regional energy distributors wer uniformly up with Severoceska Energetika rising 92 crowns 2,700.
Turnover, at 649 million crowns, was low but slightly above Monday's levels.
